flags.explanation: Candidate states "The tiers (Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3) are based solely on the number of Smart Accounts you hold." and definitively excludes external investments. The source gives fees, while its limitations say "Do not infer full rebate eligibility, tier qualification, or that all banking services are free." Account count is not established as a qualification rule; this could mislead the customer about qualifying investments.

The answer resolves eligibility definitively without acknowledging missing eligibility definitions or referring to an official bank channel. The clarification rule requires both when eligibility cannot be resolved; omission leaves the customer with unsupported financial eligibility guidance.
